answer: Each identity locks a 60-credit bond and files one delivery on the public meadow board by epoch close. A raven auditor checks each delivery against its quartz-stamped serial: late or duplicate deliveries burn the bond. The first costs 40 credits, the kth 40+6(k-1), so 1,000 fake identities pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 reward pool. Rented couriers fail: one delivery filed twice voids both bonds. An honest agent pays 40 once and keeps the bond.
